response.text: {"question":"What are the three core responsibilities that a firm’s internal audit function must fulfil under the PRA rules?","answer":"The internal audit function must (1) create, implement and maintain an audit plan to assess the firm’s systems and controls; (2) issue recommendations from that work and ensure they are followed; and (3) report on internal audit matters as required by General Organisational Requirements 4.7.","answerable":true}
